name: The Cyber-Controller
oracle_text:
When The Cyber-Controller enters, each opponent mills X cards. Put all creature cards milled this way onto the battlefield face down under your control. They're 2/2 Cyberman artifact creatures.
Other artifact creatures you control get +1/+1.
blocked_sentences: When The Cyber-Controller enters, each opponent mills X cards. Put all creature cards milled this way onto the battlefield face down under your control. They're 2/2 Cyberman artifact creatures.

needs.what: a way to put cards onto the battlefield face down with overridden face-down characteristics (708.2a-style: here a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature with no name or abilities instead of the plain 2/2 colorless Creature shell), e.g. a `face_down_as: {types: [Artifact, Creature], subtypes: [Cyberman]}` option on return_from_graveyard/put_onto_battlefield/manifest that replaces FACE_DOWN_CHARS for those objects only while they stay face down
needs.why_existing_wont_do: return_from_graveyard with face_down: true (over the cards bound by mill's `as`, controller: you) puts them down as the fixed FACE_DOWN_CHARS shell, a plain 2/2 Creature with no Artifact type or Cyberman subtype, so the card's own anthem would not even pump them. Following it with a permanent `animate` adding Artifact/Cyberman is an approximation: it is a layer-4 effect that survives the card being turned face up (a milled morph/disguise creature), whereas the printed text only defines the face-down characteristics
